description: React to a message with ONE emoji. Use sparingly: not all the time, just when you choose, and only if it relevantly complements the chat in a friendly way (thank someone back, mark a request done with a check, celebrate good news, show you are on it). Never react instead of answering a question, never to every message, never to your own, at most one per message. Calling it again with the same emoji removes yours.

emoji.description: Exactly one emoji, e.g. a thumbs up or a check mark.

message_id.description: The id of the message to react to (the incoming message's message_id).

name: react_to_message
